pages.title: Within 16 blocks
text: Everything on these pages needs your attuned familiar within **16 blocks** of you, following or waiting. Without one, your magic works just as it always has.

pages.title: Spirit Charms
text: A worn charm that carries the familiar's voice costs **40% less Pulse** to keep up, rounded: a one-voice charm's 2 Pulse becomes 1. See [Spirit Charms](spirit_charms).
Each voice you share also adds a boon, which lingers a few seconds after you part:
- **Fire**: Haste, and attackers burn twice as long.

pages.title: Spiritgear
text: A piece linked to the familiar's voice spends **40% less Pulse**, rounded: a blow's 3 becomes 2 and a swing's 2 becomes 1.
Its voice perks (extra logs and saplings, double harvests, clay from dirt) come **half again as often**. See [Spiritgear](spiritgear).

pages.title: Songs and rites
text: Verses of the familiar's voice strike **30% harder**, and a call reaches **1.5 blocks** further ([the Song Bench](song_bench)).
A seal rite of its voice leaves a blessing that lasts **half again as long**.
